title: New Metrics to Evaluate the Performance and Fairness of Personalized Federated Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes and evaluates new performance and fairness metrics for personalized federated learning algorithms on the CIFAR-10 image dataset.
findings: This paper has no findings related to religion, as its focus is on developing and evaluating metrics for personalized federated learning in a non-religious context.
